title: How Driving in Silence Clears a Godly Man's Head
caption:
Podcast on before the car's out of the driveway. Another one on the way home. Hours of other men's voices in your head every week.

Then you wonder why you can't hear God.

Try one week of driving to work in silence. The first five minutes will be loud. Then the real stuff comes up, and that's where the prayer you keep skipping finally happens.

“Be still, and know that I am God.” Psalm 46:10

Save this and try it Monday.

#faith #godlyman #christianmen #prayer #silence
